citations.title: Hermes Makes Executive Committee Appointments, Elevates Sustainability Role

sentences.quote: The appointments follow the planned departure of Olivier Fournier, who has spent 35 years at Hermes and most recently served as executive vice president of corporate development and social affairs alongside executive chairman Axel Dumas. Fournier will retain his position as president of the Fondation d'Entreprise Hermes.
sentences.text: On 11 June 2026 Hermes International announced executive committee changes effective 1 July, following the planned departure of Olivier Fournier after 35 years, most recently executive vice-president of corporate development and social affairs, who stays president of the Fondation d'Entreprise Hermes.

Nicolas Martin, with the company since 2010, joined the committee as general secretary, leading legal, Hermes Services Groupe, audit and risk, and real estate, while Sharon MacBeath became executive vice-president of human resources and sustainability; the group called this "a new stage" in its governance.
Axel Dumas remains executive chairman, citing at the July 2026 half-year results the artisanal model and confidence for the second half.
